fresh_unit_test_rerun.note: Observed in this review before this report was saved; no new Docker execution is included.

limitations: Four authored synthetic task families and 63 distinct study base programs, not 256 independent real projects.
Distinct full public contexts do not imply disjoint semantic algorithms or disjoint individual public examples across tasks.
The deliberately buggy supplied bases establish repairability; only live model-generated failed patches establish natural failure headroom.
Saved Docker receipts were source- and task-bound and inspected, not newly re-executed by this review.
Study generation/oracle verification is offline evidence, not model performance or proof of exhaustive correctness across all allowed inputs.
Scientific conclusions remain conditional on the fixed eligibility rule and received live outcomes; no treatment-based tuning was performed.

scientific_review.contract: Public specifications cover tested policies, defaults, exact objectives and boundaries; public_task uses a complete allowlist projection. Full task information remains available independently of failed patches.

independent_formulations.dependency_resolver: Constraint traversal and DFS cycle check versus simultaneous version assignments, explicit dependency checking and iterative leaf removal.
independent_formulations.quota_intervals: Combinations and active-end heap versus bitsets and signed endpoint sweep.
independent_formulations.revision_ledger: Streaming winning-event selection versus grouped reduction; alternative rounding and clamping formulations.
independent_formulations.temporal_routes: Dijkstra over resource/visit states versus exhaustive integer-time reachability.

scientific_review.study_reference_gate: prepare.verify executes every selected study reference in Docker before freezing that allocation; this review does not extrapolate calibration Docker passes to all future study references.

study_oracle_verification.scope: offline task structure and independent oracle values; Docker reference execution is a separate required gate
